names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 februarie, «Sfântul Vasile, Episcopul Tesalonicului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιος Βασίλειος Α' ο Ομολογητής Αρχιεπίσκοπος Θεσσαλονίκης», with the rank words left off.

floruit.note: His own life.md carries four of the page's figures and says what the page will not: his ordination «must have fallen in the first patriarchate of Ignatius of Constantinople, 846 to 858»; the bull of «25 September 860»; «In 862 he set himself against the impious emperor Michael III»; and «The page prints a year, 904, in brackets at that point, without saying what it dates.» The floruit spans the first of those to the last, which is as far as the page goes.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 februarie — «Sfântul Vasile, Episcopul Tesalonicului»

attestations.note: The life the site prints ends «Pomenirea lui se face pe 1 februarie.» The site prints no troparion for him.
